0e58d266.title: A fresh pair of eyes on my cluster booking guide
0e58d266.description: I've written a one-page guide so first-timers can book time on the cluster without asking around. Could someone who has run a job recently read it through and tell me where they'd get stuck?

2b150137.title: Tuesday office hour: plan your first cluster job
2b150137.description: Every Tuesday evening at the library I'll sit with anyone who wants to run something on the cluster and help them work out what they actually need. Bring your question, not your code.

6038119f.title: Second pair of hands to refit the rack fans
6038119f.description: The back rack runs hot and I've got new fans to fit. It's a two-person job for about an hour on Saturday; I'll bring the tools and the coffee.

f99b0be8.title: Salvaged solar panel to run the cluster's status screen
f99b0be8.description: I rescued a small panel and battery that can keep the cluster's status screen going off-grid. Happy to set it up and show whoever looks after the room how it works.

3a0e340c.title: Help backing up the hall's old photo archive
3a0e340c.description: I've boxes of old community hall photos scanned onto a laptop that's on its last legs. Could someone show me how to store them safely on the shared drive so they aren't lost?

d246d062.title: Cake and a proper tidy-up for the cluster room
d246d062.description: The cluster room has become a dumping ground for boxes and cables. I'll come in on Sunday with labels, bin bags and a lemon drizzle, and leave it shipshape.

5570e021.title: Borrowing a label printer to sort the cable tangle
5570e021.description: I'm untangling the cluster's cables and want every lead labelled at both ends. Does anyone have a label printer I could borrow for an afternoon?

6f14690e.title: I'll build a rack for the spare drives
6f14690e.description: The spare drives live in a shoebox. I've good timber offcuts and can make a small labelled rack this weekend; just tell me how many slots we need.

e8bab371.title: Co-pilot to keep the cluster booking sheet honest
e8bab371.description: Bookings are getting messy and people are losing their slots. I need someone to check the sheet with me on Mondays and nudge anyone who booked and didn't turn up.

ed6393cf.title: Lifts to Saturday's cluster workshop
ed6393cf.description: I'm driving to the Saturday cluster workshop and have three spare seats. Happy to pick anyone up from the station on the way.

30403039.title: Explain the cluster to me like I'm five
30403039.description: Everyone at AI Commons talks about the cluster and I just nod along. Who'll sit with me for half an hour and walk me through what it actually does? Lunch is on me.

705e4865.title: Lunchtime walk-and-talk for anyone stuck on a problem
705e4865.description: If you've been staring at the same bug all morning, come for a brisk loop of the park with me at noon. Fresh air sorts out more problems than you'd think.

8ae5d5b8.title: Someone patient to sit with me for my first cluster job
8ae5d5b8.description: I'd like to turn the orchard's picking records into a simple harvest forecast, and I'm told the cluster can help. I'll need someone unhurried beside me the first time.

4c23a049.title: A shady bench and ripe apples while your jobs run
4c23a049.description: If you're waiting on a long job, the orchard bench is in the shade and the apples are ready. Come and wait it out with me; the kettle's always on.

03da1041.title: Testers for my beginner's cluster notebook
03da1041.description: I've written a step-by-step notebook that runs a small model on the cluster from scratch. I need a fresh pair of eyes to try it and tell me exactly where it stops making sense.

61a710a8.title: Free maths help for anyone new to the cluster
61a710a8.description: If the maths behind what the cluster does feels like a wall, I'll take you through it slowly. Thursday evenings at the library, any level, no question too basic.

7d6525b9.title: Spare keyboards and mice for the cluster desk
7d6525b9.description: The spare desk by the cluster has no keyboard at all. If you've a working one gathering dust, I'll clean it up and give it a good home.

051caaa0.title: I'll fix the flaky power strip on rack two
051caaa0.description: Rack two's power strip cuts out if you look at it wrong. I'll swap it for a decent one and check the rest of the wiring while I'm in there.

99ab813a.title: Two more pairs of eyes for Sunday's bee count
99ab813a.description: I'm doing the monthly bee count along the corridor and could use two more counters. No experience needed; I'll bring clipboards and show you what to look for.

b952b6aa.title: Hedgehog gaps cut neatly in your back fence
b952b6aa.description: I've a small saw and a template for a hedgehog gap, about the size of a saucer. Tell me which fence is yours and I'll make the hole tidy and safe.

1da8b6dd.title: Planters wanted for the verge by the school gate
1da8b6dd.description: The school has given us the verge outside the gate and the wildflower plugs arrive on Friday. I need four or five people for a couple of hours to get them in the ground.

c13ac77d.title: Native wildflower seed packets for your patch
c13ac77d.description: We saved plenty of native wildflower seed last year. I'll make up packets for anyone planting a patch along the corridor, with a note on when to sow.

ad9bf4a8.title: Which flowers bring bees to a vegetable patch?
ad9bf4a8.description: My courgettes and beans are flowering like mad but I hardly see a bee. Who knows which flowers to tuck between the rows to tempt them in?

c42c40af.title: Courgettes and beans for anyone working on the corridor
c42c40af.description: My patch has gone completely overboard. Anyone who puts in a shift on the corridor can take home a bag of courgettes and runner beans; I insist.

94109bd9.title: Strong backs to shift compost for the corridor beds
94109bd9.description: Three cubic metres of compost arrived for the corridor beds and it isn't moving itself. Saturday morning, bring gloves; it's a better workout than the gym.

568f604a.title: Sunday fitness session with a planting finish
568f604a.description: This month my free Sunday session in the park ends with twenty minutes of digging along the corridor. Come for the workout, stay for the plants.

9f43f45a.title: Help sorting the shed so we can find the bee hotels
9f43f45a.description: The shed is so full that the bee hotels we built are lost behind the hoses. I need one helper for a morning to sort it, label it and make room.

ee43ef68.title: A shadow board for the corridor team's tools
ee43ef68.description: Every tool on its own hook with its outline painted behind it, so you can see at a glance what's out. I'll make one for the corridor shed if someone can lend me a drill.

0a6d37b7.title: Untreated timber for three raised pollinator beds
0a6d37b7.description: I'm building three raised beds at the end of the corridor and need untreated timber; old pallets or decking boards are perfect. I can collect.

66a46119.title: Children's bug hunt along the corridor
66a46119.description: Bring the children, a jam jar and your curiosity on Saturday morning. We'll find out who lives in the corridor and put every creature back where we found it.

f449f277.title: Someone to water the new plugs while I'm away
f449f277.description: I'll be away for five days just as the new plugs go in. Could someone water them morning or evening? I'll leave the key to the water butt with you.

76ccf3cc.title: Fresh eggs for corridor volunteers
76ccf3cc.description: The hens are laying well. Anyone who gives an hour to the corridor this month can collect half a dozen eggs from my gate.

c19bdab2.title: A second wheelbarrow for mulching day
c19bdab2.description: Mulching day is Saturday and one wheelbarrow between twelve people is a bottleneck. If you've a barrow to lend, I'll bring it back clean.

c4357174.title: Pallet trellises for the climbers along the fence
c4357174.description: I've a stack of old pallets and a free weekend. I'll turn them into trellises for honeysuckle and clematis along the corridor fence.

985b29c7.title: Crew for the creek clean-up before planting
985b29c7.description: Before we plant the creek end of the corridor, the rubbish has to come out. Join me Sunday at nine; I'll bring grabbers, bags and a flask of tea for everyone.

3d37367f.title: Tea and a gazebo for every planting day
3d37367f.description: I'll bring the big gazebo and a proper urn of tea to every planting day this season, so nobody gets rained off or goes thirsty.

0fcfa740.title: Helpers to catalogue a garage full of donated tools
0fcfa740.description: A neighbour donated a whole garage of tools and they're sitting in crates. I need a couple of people on Wednesday evening to check, clean and catalogue them.

f19eacdc.title: I'll take the Saturday morning shift at the counter
f19eacdc.description: I can run the tool library counter from nine to twelve on Saturdays for the next month, signing tools out and back in and keeping the kettle going.

38df7676.title: Loan of a ladder to clear the bird boxes
38df7676.description: The bird boxes along the river path need emptying before nesting season, and my ladder is too short. A three-metre ladder for an afternoon would do it.

3d0a18e1.title: I'll sharpen the library's hand tools
3d0a18e1.description: Spades, shears and secateurs all go blunt by spring. I'll spend an afternoon putting an edge on everything in the library.

f0434396.title: Show me how to use the tile cutter
f0434396.description: I want to retile the hall kitchen's splashback but I've never touched a tile cutter. Could someone who has show me on a few spare tiles first?

51a5de10.title: Help for new neighbours joining the tool library
51a5de10.description: I'll sit by the counter on Thursday evenings and help new neighbours join, find what they need and book it out.

a4b68765.title: Borrowing a post-hole digger for a park pull-up bar
a4b68765.description: I'd like to put up a simple pull-up bar in the park corner for everyone to use. Does the library have a post-hole digger, or does anyone own one?

c9a34b53.title: Heavy lifting for big donations
c9a34b53.description: If big donations need collecting, like workbenches, mowers or cabinets, call me. I've a van at weekends and I don't mind the lifting.

283eefd8.title: Clamps and a hand to glue up a bench
283eefd8.description: I'm making a bench for the library's front step and need four sash clamps and someone to hold the other end while the glue sets.

c30e7191.title: I'll fix the library's wobbly workbench
c30e7191.description: The workbench in the back room rocks every time you plane on it. I'll level it, brace the legs and give the top a fresh coat of oil.

691df287.title: Help labelling the shelves before we reopen
691df287.description: The shelves are rebuilt but nothing is labelled yet. I need one or two people on Friday to give every tool a home and print the labels.

cf35a2e0.title: A sign-out board so every tool comes back
cf35a2e0.description: I'll set up a board with a card for every tool and a hook for every card. It takes a morning and saves a lot of searching later.

7648a6d3.title: Co-host for a monthly how-to evening
7648a6d3.description: So many of us borrow tools we've never used. I'd love someone handy to co-host a monthly how-to evening at the library with me; I'll bring the soup.

cf5ddfa0.title: Soup and bread for tool library volunteers
cf5ddfa0.description: Everyone who works a shift at the tool library this month gets a bowl of soup and fresh bread at my place afterwards.

e1addbf7.title: Broken power tools wanted for spare parts
e1addbf7.description: Got a drill or sander that's given up? Don't bin it. I'll strip it for parts to keep the library's tools running.

cc63b9b1.title: Repair clinic for the library's power tools
cc63b9b1.description: Bring any of the library's misbehaving power tools on Saturday afternoon and we'll work out what's wrong together, bench and multimeter ready.

b2d13aab.title: Measuring roofs for the microgrid map
b2d13aab.description: We're mapping which roofs on the street could take panels. I need someone with a good tape and a steady ladder to help me measure a dozen roofs this month.

23bd0994.title: Hosting the monthly microgrid meeting
23bd0994.description: I'll host the monthly microgrid meeting in my front room and keep it to an hour, with tea and an honest look at the numbers.

6370716a.title: Will panels on my roof disturb the swifts?
6370716a.description: Swifts nest under my eaves every summer. Before we fit panels, I'd like someone who knows to check we won't block their way in.

b59cf807.title: Nest boxes fitted beside every new panel install
b59cf807.description: Wherever panels go up, I'll fit a swift or sparrow box alongside so the birds don't lose out. I've a dozen ready to go.

68966da4.title: Help writing a plain-English microgrid explainer
68966da4.description: Half the street still isn't sure what the microgrid means for their bill. I need someone who understands it to help me write a clear page for the newsletter.

b35c85b8.title: Door-knocking for the roof survey
b35c85b8.description: I'll spend two evenings knocking on doors to explain the roof survey and collect sign-ups. Happy to pair up with anyone who'd like to come along.

45cbb398.title: How does the shared battery actually work?
45cbb398.description: I keep hearing 'shared battery' and I want to understand it properly before I sign up. Who'll talk me through it over a coffee?

e04ed50b.title: Carrying panels on install days
e04ed50b.description: Panels are heavy and awkward. On install days I'll be there to carry them up ladders and scaffolding for whoever's fitting.

b65d1373.title: An electrician to look over my old fuse board
b65d1373.description: My fuse board is older than I am. Before my roof joins the microgrid, I'd like a qualified electrician to check it and tell me straight what needs doing.

dfde80fd.title: Battens and mounting rails cut to size
dfde80fd.description: I can cut and treat battens for anyone's panel mounts in my workshop. Send me the measurements and they'll be ready within a week.

8cb46cb2.title: Help clearing my loft so the inverter can go in
8cb46cb2.description: The inverter has to go in my loft, and the loft needs a good clear-out first. One helper for a morning; whatever we don't keep goes to the swap shelf.

30ea1a8e.title: A tidy cable route for every new install
30ea1a8e.description: Before each install I'll sketch a simple cable route for the house, so the wires run neatly and nothing gets tripped over.

77a8ffd8.title: Someone patient to help older neighbours sign up
77a8ffd8.description: Some of our older neighbours want to join the microgrid, but the forms put them off. I'm looking for a patient helper to sit with them one afternoon.

303b4e32.title: My kitchen and kettle for microgrid questions
303b4e32.description: My kitchen is free on the first Monday of the month. Bring your questions about the microgrid; I'll bring the kettle and the cake.

c7ae13d1.title: A spare little computer board for the energy display
c7ae13d1.description: I'm building a small screen that shows how much the street's panels are making. If you have a small computer board or an old tablet going spare, it would be perfect.

4a8e401f.title: I'll build a live energy display for the hall
4a8e401f.description: I'll put together a simple screen in the hall that shows, as it happens, how much power our roofs are making and storing. Children love watching the numbers move.

20b2abf4.title: I'll sharpen the library's hand tools
20b2abf4.description: Spades, shears and secateurs all go blunt by spring. I'll spend an afternoon putting an edge on everything in the library.

69cdd916.description: I will teach anyone who is curious how to record, edit and publish a podcast. Bring your story; the gear is provided.

10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005.description: A first walk along the street with a tape and a notebook to list which roofs could take panels. We stopped once it turned out the survey had already been done.

10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004.description: Two Saturday afternoons at the Repair Café bench, restoring an old hand plane together until it took a shaving as fine as paper.

10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003.description: An evening in the community hall: eight neighbours learned to record and edit a short audio story, with the room set up and the kettle going.

10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002.description: Seven graphics cards pledged to the shared cluster for open research, set up so anyone in AI Commons can book time on them.

10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.description: After the storm flattened the garden fence, a Saturday crew reset the posts and rehung the panels, and stayed until every one was solid.
